resources.string: Short notes on what changed and how to use it. Tap a version to read more.
A personal note with every update

Every update note now ends with a little message from me, including older notes in Settings → Patch notes. You can always open them again there.\n\nTo send me a transcription problem, open a lecture → Report a problem. Select the part and the audio or text you want to include, then Prepare report → Share report → WhatsApp → our chat.
A small window for new updates

You can now find short update notes in Settings → Patch notes. This window appears once for each new version. Older notes stay in the history.\n\nAlso included: problem reports. Open a lecture → Report a problem, choose a passage or time range, and tick the audio and text you want to include. Tap Prepare report, check the contents, then Share report → WhatsApp → our chat. Nothing is sent automatically.

A lecture now has a Report a problem button. Choose the whole lecture, a passage or a time range, then add a note or the correct words if you like.

For wrong or missing words, tick Include the selected audio and Include the selected transcript. Both start off. Tap Prepare report to check what is included, then Share report → WhatsApp → our chat. Save a copy keeps the report as a ZIP file.

Stop recording or pause transcription before preparing a report. Your lecture stays in scribe. Deleted audio cannot be attached.
A new look, dark theme and help

scribe has a puffin icon and new colours. Settings → Dark theme switches to darker colours.\n\nSettings → Help explains recording, listening, correcting text and keeping your audio. Menus and help are available in English and Romanian.

Record or import a lecture and get a transcript on your tablet after recording stops. Organise lectures by course, mark important moments and export the text.\n\nTap a text passage to listen to its recording. Hold the passage to correct the words. Check the text before relying on it, especially names and specialist terms.
